Command Presence.name: Command Presence
Command Presence.description:
📣 People listen when you give an order in a crisis.

🎯 Good for team leaders, teachers and agency heads.
📋 Requires level 16 and Leadership 15.

📈 Grants: Leadership +10
Command Presence.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has led people through danger and it shows: their orders are short and clear, they assign tasks by people's strengths and they take responsibility when it goes wrong. In a crisis, classmates, sidekicks, bystanders or gang members turn to them for direction. Show it in decisive calls and a voice that carries. Limits: authority still comes from rank and law; a pro at the scene, a teacher or a superior in their organization outranks them, and people follow bad orders less willingly each time.
